QuestInfo.name: The Ellin Forest Incident
QuestInfo.0: Agent N wants to talk to you. He may have new intel for you.
QuestInfo.1: Agent N wants to talk to you. He may have new intel for you.
QuestInfo.2:
You are able to go to Ellin Forest on Victoria Island right after the Black Mage gets sealed, through the Time Control Room in Helios Tower 100th Floor.
Go and ask #bWiz the Librarian#k in #bHelios Tower Library#k about Ellin Forest as he knows something about it.

0.0: Hey! It's been a while! I got some new intel for you, fresh out of the oven.\r\n#L0##bSpeak.#l\n#k
0.1: We found a passageway to the past on top of Helios Tower. You know, by Ludibrium. The Black Mage's fingerprints are all over this. This could be the break you're looking for!

yes.0: The passageway starts at the Time Control Room on the 100th floor of Helios Tower. Good luck!

no.0: Huh. I thought you were going after the Black Mage.
